title: Drops in the small cave
author: Selector
changes: Real recording of water drops falling and echoing inside the Ledyanaya cave near Staritsa, Russia, used for the glowworm (glowworms make no sound). Trimmed to 71.90–74.75 s of the original, mixed to mono, gentle 12 dB/oct high-pass at 70 Hz, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. Taken from the Freesound high-quality MP3 preview of the recording; the recordist notes a limiter and light denoising were applied to the original. The 70 Hz high-pass removes measured low-frequency rumble.
